overview: Gödel’s notebooks decoded by AI reveal hundreds of unknown theorems, highlighting AI’s role in historical research.
Nvidia’s leadership change threatens its massive AI‑startup funding pipeline, raising uncertainty for the ecosystem.
OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, enabling AI agents to make purchases under user‑controlled safeguards.

top.title: AI unlocks Gödel's notebooks, said to contain hundreds of proved theorems
top.summary: AI model Claude processed Gödel’s 1,009‑page shorthand notebooks, summarizing hundreds of previously unknown theorems and suggesting 14 unexplored logical themes, demonstrating AI’s capacity to accelerate scholarly text analysis.

top.title: Nvidia Allegedly Engineered Scarcity by Funding AI Startups to Buy Its GPUs
top.summary: Reports allege Nvidia deliberately created GPU scarcity by financing AI startups that purchase its hardware, a strategy that may manipulate market supply and demand.

top.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
top.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation ends Nvidia’s aggressive AI‑startup investing; interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to adopt a more conservative approach, potentially reducing capital flow to early‑stage AI firms.

top.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
top.summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet for Pro users, allowing Dots agents to purchase items after biometric verification and tokenized payment, keeping actual card data hidden from agents and merchants.

top.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away
top.summary: OpenAI board member Paul Cristiano warned that rapid AI progress could lead to an “AI takeover” within months, citing recent hacking incidents as early warning signs despite lacking quantitative risk models.

top.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
top.summary: A scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged affairs with individuals linked to Chinese interests has raised national‑security concerns and coincided with his abrupt departure, adding instability to the AI chip market.
